idea.title: MapScratch
idea.tagline: Collaborative map markup for outdoor crews
idea.description: MapScratch is a collaborative map annotation tool for outdoor enthusiasts. Drop pins, draw routes, and attach notes and photos to satellite maps, then share a link for friends to add their own marks and comments. Perfect for planning group hikes, fishing trips, or city explorations without the noise of social networks.
idea.niche: Outdoor enthusiasts, hiking groups, fishing buddies, and urban explorers who want a shared visual planning space.
idea.visualDirection: Dark, utilitarian workbench with a focused map canvas, side panels for lists and details, and a bold icon beat using a map-pin glyph on the hero.
features: Drop pins on an interactive Mapbox map with custom notes and optional photo URLs.
Draw freehand routes and polylines directly on the map.
Comment on any pin or route to update trail conditions or share ideas.
Share a unique link (via URL hash) to let friends open the same map and add their own marks.
Persist all data locally in the browser using localStorage, with demo data preloaded.
idea.scopeNotes: No authentication, no backend, no payments. Map data and annotations stored in localStorage only. Mapbox used solely for the base map and drawing interactions. Share links encode a room ID in the hash but are only functional on the same browser (demo-friendly).

customBrief: MapScratch is a web app where outdoor enthusiasts can collaboratively mark up satellite maps with pins, routes, and annotations for secret spots, trail conditions, or planned adventures. Users drop pins on a Mapbox map, attach photos and notes, and share a link for friends to comment and add their own marks. It's perfect for planning group hikes, fishing trips, or city explorations without the noise of social networks.

brand.voice: Quietly utilitarian — speaks like a well-worn field notebook, direct and unpretentious. It lets the map do the talking.

sections.name: Drafting Table
sections.purpose: Establish the core loop: see the map, start marking immediately — no onboarding fluff.
sections.visualBeat: A dark canvas fills the viewport, with a single pin glowing in the accent color, surrounded by faint route sketches and a side panel listing notes.

sections.name: Markers & Trails
sections.purpose: Show how pins, routes, and comments layer into a shared visual conversation.
sections.visualBeat: Split view: left shows a clustered map with varied pin shapes and a dotted polyline; right shows a thread of timestamped comments attached to a pin.

sections.name: Field Notes
sections.purpose: Demonstrate the note-and-photo attachment workflow integrated with the map surface.
sections.visualBeat: A modal-like panel overlays the map, displaying a pin detail — a photo thumbnail, a text note, and a small comment input, all in muted cards.

sections.name: Share Loop
sections.purpose: Highlight the frictionless share-by-link mechanism that makes collaboration instant.
sections.visualBeat: A simple URL bar with a copy button, and a subtle animation of a link 'snapping' to the map, with avatars of collaborators appearing at the edge.

brand.heroComposition: First viewport: a bold 'workbench' header with the MapScratch logo (≥72px) on the left, a TextReveal headline 'Shared maps, marked together' center-right, and a single 'Start mapping' CTA below the headline, against a dark map-grid backdrop with faint contour lines.
brand.logoMarkDescription: A single continuous teardrop-shaped pin with an inner circle cut-out, built from two perfect arcs, in a flat slate accent color.
